cases.title: Toggle Text Box Visibility via Toggle Button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid="toggle-button") changes the visibility of the text box (data-testid="text-box") by adding or removing the 'show' class according to the user interaction, starting from an initially hidden state and reflecting the final state correctly.

cases.title: Show text box via toggle button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') makes the text box (data-testid='text-box') visible by adding the 'show' class.

cases.title: Hide text box via close button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Close' button (data-testid='close-button') inside the visible text box hides the text box by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Text Box Open
cases.description: Verify that when the user opens the text box using the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button'), the system invokes the getVoices function to populate the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') with option elements containing voice names and languages.

cases.title: Update Voice Dropdown on voiceschanged Event
cases.description: Verify that if available voices change, the system listens for the 'voiceschanged' event and updates the dropdown accordingly.

cases.title: Assign Selected Voice to Message Voice
cases.description: Verify that when a user selects a voice from the dropdown, it is assigned to message.voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Select Voice from Choose Voice Dropdown
cases.description: Verify that users can select a voice from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') and the system sets the chosen voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Dropdown Populated on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that the 'Choose Voice' dropdown is populated with available voices when the page is fully loaded.

cases.title: Multiple Voice Selections and Last Selected Active Voice
cases.description: Verify that the system handles multiple voice selections, ensuring that the last selected voice is set as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Voice Options with Specific Language Codes
cases.description: Verify that the application supports voice options that include specific language codes, such as 'CN' for Chinese or 'US' for English, and accurately sets the voice containing these codes as the active voice when selected.

cases.title: Read Entered Text Aloud Using Selected Voice
cases.description: Verify that when the user toggles the text box via the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button'), enters text into the textarea (data-testid='text-area'), selects a voice from the dropdown (data-testid='voice-select'), and clicks the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'), the system uses the selected voice to read the entered text aloud.

cases.title: Verify dynamic generation of predefined phrase boxes
cases.description: Verify that the system dynamically generates predefined phrase boxes in the main section based on a data array, where each box contains an image and a paragraph representing a phrase.

cases.title: Verify phrase box click interaction for speech and highlight
cases.description: Verify that when a user clicks on a phrase box, the system reads the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box by adding the active class for 800 milliseconds.

cases.title: Verify handling of normal clicks, sequential clicks, and rapid repeated clicks on phrase boxes
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly handles normal clicks, sequential clicks across different boxes, and rapid repeated clicks on the same box, ensuring speech playback and visual feedback are triggered accurately.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and their explicitly stated behaviors (normal, edge, boundary conditions such as rapid repeated clicks, sequential clicks, multiple voice selections, language codes, and event listeners) have matching test cases. No blockers or missing scenario gaps were found.
All requirements and explicit scenarios are thoroughly covered by the provided test cases. No blockers or missing scenario gaps found.

coverage.feedback: The accepted cases cover the core functional workflows described across the requirements nicely. However, there are coverage gaps, overgenerations, and excess behaviors tested that require refinement. Gaps include missing explicit coverage for rapid repeated clicks and boundary conditions on the text box toggle as specified in R-1. Excess and overgeneration include testing initial page load voice population in R-4 (which conflicts with R-3's specification that voices populate when the text box is opened) and testing speculative/unstated rapid-fire edge cases on phrase boxes in R-6 beyond standard interaction. The test suite should strictly align with the actions explicitly stated in the requirement text without fabricating extra stress-test scenarios.
